verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS tax-compliance product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes TaxJar's hosted API, including a hosted sandbox endpoint, and open-source API client libraries, none of which let you run the core product on your own infrastructure. There is no evidence of a self-hostable distribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
